script.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its true detail "Sabbath" is named in line 4, which gives it away. Burn a detail no other line mentions.

terra.problem: The blessed man is not described as maintaining justice or keeping his hand from doing evil.
The eunuchs are not described as choosing what pleases the LORD.
The foreigners are not described as joining themselves to the LORD, loving His name, or keeping the Sabbath without profaning it.
